mechanism.claim: At the completed 21:00 UTC crypto settlement day, an upper-tail expansion in the Corwin-Schultz two-day OHLC-implied bid-ask spread identifies a transitory liquidity-cost shock. In a high realized-variation state, fade the completed one-day BTC displacement for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the completed 24-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCSER estimates latent spread from the joint algebra of two adjacent daily high-low ranges and their combined two-day range. AARMR measures one-hour interval overlap, RBEFR compares intrabar range to candle bodies, HVLIR divides hourly return by turnover, and HVSAR uses serial return dependence. No prior event set, control, volume, flow, funding, OI, premium, or external asset is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both completed 24-hour realized variation and positive Corwin-Schultz spread expansion must be causal upper-tail states
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse 21:05 UTC latent-spread expansion clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.daily_windows: two adjacent exact 24-hour windows [D-48h,D-24h) and [D-24h,D), each from 1,440 exact coherent one-minute BTCUSDT bars
features.daily_high_low: maximum high and minimum low in each completed window; all strict positive
features.spread_expansion: current implied spread minus the immediately prior valid decision implied spread; strict positive
features.spread_expansion_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 previous valid expansions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open) over the current completed 24-hour window)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 previous valid days, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.completed_return: log(last close/first open) over current window; strict nonzero

clock.decision: exact daily 21:00 UTC after both OHLC windows complete
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent two-day latent bid-ask-spread expansion mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no estimator, threshold, side, hold, clock, window, subset, or control repair.
